answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond, pays a 10-credit fee per epoch, and answers three small probes from an orchard archive. Each probe pairs one orchard template with fresh nebula parameters, recomputed by auditors; a copying ring fails because parameters differ per identity. Failure doubles next epoch probes to six plus a recheck; a second burns the bond. Assignments and answers sit on a trellis board for anyone to recompute. The thousandth fake locks 70 and owes three fresh solutions, so 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 and pay 10,000 each epoch, while honesty costs 70 once and 10 per epoch.
